## What to build

Build the Frontier Reviewer decision path and tiered repair policy. Review outcomes should be evidence-based and should update the Issue Slice, Local Agent session, and mission summary consistently.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Review outcomes support Approved, Approved with limitations, Needs repair, Needs human review, and Rejected.
- [x] Missing or invalid evidence prevents Approved outcomes.
- [x] First rejection routes repair to the same Local Agent.
- [x] Second rejection routes repair to a fresh Local Agent.
- [x] Repeated architecture failure routes back to Frontier Architect revision.
- [x] Critical, security, or merge-risk failure escalates to the user.
source_issue.title: 06 — Frontier Review and Repair Policy

behavior: Current /review with no-risk NeedsRepair or Rejected commits parent review and inherited Proposed repair child in one receipt/transaction.
Child requires fresh explicit approval; no model/check runs inside review. Risk-bearing reviews still hold without child.
Parent and child Activity filters show the compound receipt; readiness names linked child.
Review notes, acceptance criteria and compound rejection counts follow repair lineage.
Open-scope, evidence, coverage, unresolved-child and capacity guards apply atomically. Exact replay returns same child.
Exact v1-v13 backups; earlier schemas reject compound receipt. Historical Decide/Assess/Review semantics remain unchanged.
